notes.title: Update Notes 2.0.3
Update Notes 2.0.2
notes.content:
Update Notes 2.0.2


New and optimize:

-Added visual effects for multiplay room list refresh in the main menu.
-Added some ambiance voiceovers for multiplay.
-Optimized the algorithm of tasks in multiplay.
-Optimized the animation of the "Center Control" display screen in multiplay.
-Optimized some text in multiplay.


Fix the issue:

-Fixed the error when multiple players grab one package the same time in multiplay.
-Fixed the issue of player movement display errors in multiplay.
-Fixed the animation of submission area in multiplay.


Special Notice:

In multiplay, if you cannot see a newly created room in the room list (even after clicking the "Refresh" button), restarting the game can resolve this. The known cause of this issue is a network refresh problem.

"Package Runner" is now released!
notes.content:
"Package Runner" is now released! 10% off first week!

"Package Runner" is the first game of Oddity Works; It is a J-style role-play game set in cyberpunk concept, with a cozy puzzle gameplay; In the game, you will play the role of the clone girl named NO.22 to explore the secrets and truth of the Zenith Company within 50 working weeks. We hope that you enjoy it. In the future, we will continue to receive feedback from everyone and optimize updates to make the game better!

By the way, in the new year, after "Package Runner" 's follow-up work, our new project is also in W.I.P. . Follow our studio if your like. Thank you!
